How Low Can PG&E Stock Go When The Risk Is Its Own?
summary: PG&E (PCG) trades at about $12.94, the bottom of its 52-week range and about 32% below its high. Over the past twelve months it lost 12.2% while the S&P 500 gained 18.5%. That gap did not come from a market crash. And in market shocks since 2007, its deepest fall includes a one-day break in PG&E's own price data.

title: IDACORP Hikes Dividend 2.3% to Strengthen Shareholder Returns
summary: IDA raises its quarterly dividend by 2.3% to 90 cents, extending annual increases since 2011 as customer growth and investments support returns.
